breakouts.h: Next up: the breakout candidates for the new season
breakouts.d: Rating jumps from offseason training, new starting jobs, scheme fits and what they did with limited snaps last year. These are the names to know before kickoff.

list.name: E.Marquez
list.d: [[p:557715517|E.Marquez]] is penciled in as a starter for the first time. Add this: LSU threw it more than almost anyone last year (3rd in passing yards per game). Plus, he brings a speedster skill set to a scheme that ranks 2nd in receptions. By October, everyone will know it.

list.d: [[p:557725294|S.Cordova]] slides into the starting lineup with D.Hacker gone. Better yet, Notre Dame leans on the run game (22nd in rushing yards per game last year).
